value: FastText is an open-source library developed by Facebook AI Research for efficient learning of word representations and text classification.
content: FastText is an open-source library developed by Facebook AI Research for efficient learning of word representations and text classification.

value: It extends traditional word embedding models like Word2Vec by representing words as n-gram character sequences rather than single tokens, enabling it to handle out-of-vocabulary words and morphologically rich languages effectively.
content: It extends traditional word embedding models like Word2Vec by representing words as n-gram character sequences rather than single tokens, enabling it to handle out-of-vocabulary words and morphologically rich languages effectively.

value: FastText generates dense vector representations that capture semantic and syntactic relationships between words, making it particularly useful for tasks like sentiment analysis, text classification, and language modeling.
content: FastText generates dense vector representations that capture semantic and syntactic relationships between words, making it particularly useful for tasks like sentiment analysis, text classification, and language modeling.

value: The model supports both supervised and unsupervised training, offers pre-trained embeddings for many languages, and is designed for scalability, allowing it to process large datasets quickly while maintaining high accuracy.

value: Its architecture combines skip-gram with negative sampling for training efficiency, and it can be fine-tuned for specific downstream NLP tasks.
